exposure.needed: whether the environment uses Loki's embedded cache and whether its dashboards, alert rules or PromQL queries reference metrics under the old querier_cache_ prefix

consequence.statement: Loki keeps working, but embedded-cache metrics are now published under the loki_embeddedcache_ prefix, so dashboards, alerts or queries still referencing the old querier_cache_ metric names will no longer see those series, and the duplicate metrics no longer exist.
consequence.remediation: Update any dashboards, alert rules or queries that reference the old querier_cache_ metric prefix to use loki_embeddedcache_.

assertion.statement: Loki's embedded cache metrics are now exposed under the loki_embeddedcache_ prefix instead of querier_cache_, and duplicate metrics are removed (PR 10693).
